summary: St. Joe NF site in Shoshone County: tent in 1927, L-4 cab in 1931, destroyed in 1961; no remnants found, rock carvings reported.

facts.design: L-4 cab atop the west summit (1931), after a 1927 tent
facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1961; no remnants of the lookout were found, though carvings in the rocks remain

events.note: Joe Coddington staffed the summit with a tent and a mapboard; the source says he may have staffed it for multiple years

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The sources disagree: firelookout.com puts the patrol point 1.25 miles east, on Turkey Point; Idaho Fire Lookouts puts Turkey Point 1 1/2 miles east. The story reports both and does not choose.

notes_for_editor: Sources disagree on the distance to Turkey Point (1.25 vs 1 1/2 miles); the story reports both. The 1927 staffing is single-sourced and the source says 'may have staffed'. Staffing 'unstaffed' as of 1961 follows from the destruction date; no source gives a staffing end date. The Idaho Fire Lookouts remnants and carvings note comes from its article dated October 25, 2023, so it is a 2023 description. The Idaho page header spells the destruction note 'Destoryed'; the evidence quote copies the typo as printed. The access level is omitted: no source states an access rule, and the story says it is unknown whether the site is open; the drive-up label stays under visit. The record's kind 'ground' matches the FFLA list; the sources do not say whether the L-4 cab stood on a tower. Elevation is 6,300 ft per both sources; the record's elevation_m is null. No photo beyond the one already in the record was found.
